instruction: Open GitKraken and clone the public repository https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World.git into the folder ~/Documents/gk_clone_hello using HTTPS.

verification.condition: Check that ~/Documents/gk_clone_hello/.git exists and git -C ~/Documents/gk_clone_hello remote get-url origin equals "https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World.git".
verification.expected_result: The repository is cloned to ~/Documents/gk_clone_hello with remote "origin" set to the specified GitHub URL.
